questions.stem: A 35-week-gestation infant, born to a mother with poorly controlled pregestational diabetes (insulin-dependent with vascular disease, HbA1C 9%), is delivered via cesarean section due to fetal macrosomia and distress. Neonate is at risk for several complications due to the maternal diabetes and premature birth. In addition to birth asphyxia, cardiac septal hypertrophy, and polycythemia, which of the following conditions is this infant at an increased risk for?
